source: Observed Vast SDK offer gpu_name values. Keep profile allowed_gpu_names aligned with these exact strings.

notes.rtx_4090: Some Vast RTX 4090 offers report about 49140 MB and pass the 45GB gate; keep gated by min_gpu_total_ram_mb rather than assuming all 4090s are 24GB.
notes.rtx_5090: Observed Vast string is RTX 5090; expected 32GB-class Blackwell consumer card, so keep separate from 45GB+ profiles.
notes.rtx_6000_ada: Observed Vast string is RTX 6000Ada, not RTX 6000 Ada.
notes.rtx_pro_6000: Observed Vast distinguishes RTX PRO 6000 WS and RTX PRO 6000 S.
notes.h100: Do not include H100 names until observed in current Vast offer results for this query.
